title: ABC Event v0.1
description: One event in the life of a street animal under India's Animal Birth Control (Dogs) Rules 2023. Fields map to Rule 12(1) (capture/release register), Schedule III (per-veterinarian monthly return) and Schedule IV (daily counts). Identity key is the NDDB 15-digit ISO 11784 number where the animal is chipped; local_id otherwise. Localities are zones or wards — precise coordinates are not permitted in this schema. Licence: CC-BY-4.0.

event_type.description: capture/release: Rule 12(1). sterilisation: Schedule III. observation/death: Schedule IV columns.

tag_number.description: Rule 11(8): numbered collar/tag assigned on arrival.

local_id.description: Identifier in the recording system, e.g. pawbook:8089.

locality.description: Rule 12(1)(i) area of capture, or 12(1)(vi) place of release. A zone or ward name, never a coordinate.

performed_by.description: Rule 12(1)(iii) capturing squad, or the NGO / Project Implementing Agency.

vet_registration_no.description: Schedule III: Veterinary Council registration number.

ear_notch.description: Rule 11(16): V-notch on the right ear. Observed only; not proof of sterilisation.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 of a certificate or photo held elsewhere.

source.description: Provenance tier. Only pho_record and awo_certificate should count toward a return an officer signs.

recorded_by.description: Pseudonym of the recorder. Never a legal identity, phone or email.
